source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    key_cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 8)]
    shape_cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    kr0 = min(r for r, c in key_cells)
    kr1 = max(r for r, c in key_cells)
    kc0 = min(c for r, c in key_cells)
    kc1 = max(c for r, c in key_cells)
    sr0 = min(r for r, c in shape_cells)
    sr1 = max(r for r, c in shape_cells)
    sc0 = min(c for r, c in shape_cells)
    sc1 = max(c for r, c in shape_cells)
    key = [row[kc0:kc1 + 1] for row in grid[kr0:kr1 + 1]]
    rotated = [list(row) for row in zip(*key[::-1])]
    scale = (sr1 - sr0 + 1) // len(rotated)
    for i, row in enumerate(rotated):
        for j, color in enumerate(row):
            if color:
                for dr in range(scale):
                    for dc in range(scale):
                        out[sr0 + i * scale + dr][sc0 + j * scale + dc] = color
    return out
'''
